3  Population

3.1 Overall Summary

About 1.5 million Mississippians, half of the state’s population of 3 million, lived within the Mississippi Sound Watershed in 2020. The total population of the Mississippi Sound Watershed, which includes portions of Alabama and Louisiana, in 2020 was about 1.7 million. See Table 3.1 for the breakdown.

Population in the Mississippi Sound Watershed as a whole, within the MSEP Study Area (the portion of the MS Sound Watershed contained only within the state of Mississippi), and in the state of Mississippi itself was generally stable between 2010 and 2020 (see Table 3.1). Within the larger area, however, some subbasins had increases or decreases of up to 9% (see Table 3.2).

3.2 Supporting Information

The EPA’s EnviroAtlas provides gridded estimates of decadal US Census data for the years 2010 and 2020. These data were summarized for the region in the {msepBaselineData} R package and are presented here.

3.2.3 Maps of pop and change by subbasin

Population densities are calculated based on land area in each subbasin (i.e. the area of the Mississippi Sound is not included in calculations for the Coastal Streams Basin).

For file size purposes, the precision of the outlines in these maps has been reduced. That reduction was performed after calculating densities and change.
